description: Octopus Digital Limited is a Pakistani industrial internet-of-things and data-platform company. Its cloud-native OmniConnect platform ingests data from operational and non-operational sources and converts it into a machine-learning-ready form for analytics, prediction and new data products, sold on a subscription rather than capital-expenditure basis. It serves manufacturing, oil, gas and energy, utilities, infrastructure, textiles and fleet customers, and is part of the Avanceon group.
headOffice: 19-Km, Main Multan Road, Lahore, Punjab 54660, Pakistan
